name: GEO-Bench-2
description: GEO-Bench-2 is a comprehensive evaluation framework for Geospatial Foundation Models (GeoFMs) covering classification, segmentation, regression, object detection, and instance segmentation across 19 permissively-licensed datasets. It introduces capability groups to rank models based on shared dataset characteristics, enabling tailored model evaluation and comparison in Earth Observation tasks.
typical_sota_score: varies by task; unknown (wide range across different tasks and metrics)
reputation: A new geospatial foundation model benchmark that aims to standardize evaluation across multiple Earth Observation tasks and datasets.
notes: Includes 19 permissively-licensed datasets and introduces capability groups for model ranking; supports multiple geospatial tasks with a prescriptive evaluation protocol.
